name: Four Seasons Resort Bali at Jimbaran Bay
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary overlooks one of Bali's most coveted bays, where traditional fishing boats paint the horizon at sunset and the Indian Ocean stretches endlessly beyond.
whats_special: The resort sits on 35 acres of tropical gardens cascading down limestone cliffs to Jimbaran Bay's golden crescent beach. Each villa features a private plunge pool and outdoor pavilion, while the property's elevated position offers breathtaking 180-degree ocean views. The resort is also home to Bali's only beachfront Four Seasons spa treatment pavilions.
pro_tip: Book the Presidential Villa's private beach cabana for exclusive access to a secluded stretch of sand, complete with dedicated butler service and personalized seafood grilling.
dont_miss: The legendary Jimbaran Bay seafood dining experience right on the beach at sunset, where local fishermen's daily catch is grilled tableside in the sand. Also visit the nearby Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on 250-foot cliffs just 15 minutes away, for traditional Kecak fire dancing performances.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Jimbaran Bay
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Traditional Balinese architecture and cultural immersion
cons: Distance from Bali's cultural center in Ubud
